days.title: Eastern Ceramics and Roman Ruins
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Minori
stops.detail: In ancient times the territory of the Coast formed part of the Roman Empire, as evidenced by the presence of numerous patrician villas, the most extensive of which is located in Minori.

stops.name: Cetara
stops.detail: Among the coastal specialties, the anchovies and the 'colatura' produced in Cetara can also be mentioned, as well as the ceramics made and hand-painted in Vietri sul Mare.

stops.name: Vietri sul Mare
stops.detail: Vietri sul Mare known throughout the world for the ancient tradition of ceramic processing and its hamlet Albori, which is part of the club of the most beautiful villages in Italy.
